verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted deployment option or user-controlled mail pipeline. The documentation positions Superhuman as a client for Gmail and Outlook accounts, and a community comment reports that it stores users' emails on its own servers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
